note: Small 60+ (senior) RV park on the western shore of Pokegama Lake near Grand Rapids; grounds at lake level, and the operator calls sites 7-10 lakeside. Sand beach, marina, boat ramp. No visitors permitted. --Claude
summary: Operator's old frame site read: 60+ senior park, 10 full-hookup sites (30/20 A, 36-ft max), showers, May-October, phone/email reservations with a $30 deposit, no cards. Rate page is headed '2009 RATE SCHEDULE' with 'Contact us' instead of prices; RoverPass is an unclaimed listing (platform corrected to phone). Google 3.3/20. Drop candidate (age limit + stale/no rate + weak reviews) for the reviewer; lakeview kept.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (reviewer decides): (1) age-restricted - welcome page: 'Sugar Bay Campground/Resort is a 60+ (senior) RV park.' (the stored note said 55+); (2) no rate anywhere from the operator - the rate page is headed '2009 RATE SCHEDULE' and lists 'Full RV hook-up Campsites #'s 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 ... Contact us' and 'Full RV hook-up Lakeside Campsites #'s 7, 8, 9, 10 ... Contact us'; the website is an un-updated FrontPage site; (3) Google 3.3 from 20 reviews (under 4.0, though below the 25-review screen). Presence passes (working site + phone) and the stored RV Life $$ tier would pass price for an ordinary park, so this rests on the age limit plus 'iffy'. 'Sorry, no visitors are permitted in your campsite' / 'No visitors (non registered guests) are permitted on the campground/resort grounds'.

Booking platform: stored `roverpass` came from an unclaimed RoverPass directory page ('Claim my Campground', 'Last Updated: 11/15/2024'); the operator takes reservations by call or email. Corrected to `phone`. The RoverPass page's '$30' rate is not the operator's and was not used.

Waterfront: stored `lakeview` kept. The operator calls sites 7-10 'Lakeside' and says 'Our grounds are at lake level with great lake-views', but posts no site map; on imagery the open lawn runs east to the Pokegama Lake shore and docks, while the RV pads visible in the photo (west side of the grounds) are some 40-80 m from open water, with a reed marsh on the north. Sites 7-10 cannot be located, so no upgrade is proposed.

Pin: stored 47.18950,-93.63320 is in the woods just south of Moose Point Road; the resort grounds (and Google's pin, 47.19024,-93.63239) are ~100 m north-east across the road. Under 250 m; a reviewer may move it to about 47.1904,-93.6322.
Facilities: dump (stored, derived from the old note) was not confirmed on the pages read; left. 'Maximum capacity per site is 6 people'; 'All rates and fees are subject to Minnesota State sales tax'.
